messages:
alex: Heads-up — APAC realtime embed customers reporting p95 ~2.3s up from ~120ms since last night. Not seeing errors, just long tails.
priya: Which region/cluster? any recent rollouts?
alex: eu -> apac rollout of driver 530 started 03:10 UTC. Affected cluster ap-southeast-1-realtime-01.
cs-sara: CS got a ticket from AcmeCorp at 02:50 local, they included sample traces showing slow small-batch (1-2 request) latencies.
priya: OK repro scope: small batch, low QPS, embed endpoint. Could be kv-cache miss pattern + host io.
infra-ryan: Deploy bot shows nightly snapshots on same cluster started around 02:30 local — heavy async writes to NVMe.
deploy-bot: "snapshot-job-2026-03-16T02:30 started on nodes: ap-southeast-1-realtime-01[3,4,5]"
mike: Can we correlate p95 with hostfs write spikes? grabbing iostat + nvme stats.
alex: Attached logs: 
```
# top-level summary
p95_before: 0.12s
p95_after: 2.3s
cpu: normal
nvme_write_kB/s: spike at 02:31 -> 120000 kB/s
irq/softirq: small increase
```

infra-ryan: Running `iostat -x 1 10` shows avg await on nvme0p1 jumping from 1ms -> 18ms during snapshots.
priya: Hmm driver 530 changed NVMe DMA batching behavior we suspect. Could be kernel preempt + driver interplay causing I/O latency amplification for small reads.
cs-sara: Customer urgently needs mitigation. What are quick fallbacks?
mike: Short term: 1) route AcmeCorp traffic to pool with driver 525 (rollback pool) 2) add scheduling isolcpus on those nodes 3) postpone snapshots or throttle them.
alex: Can we do routing fast? Is there capacity in 525 pool?
infra-ryan: 525 pool has headroom ~20% for small-batch endpoints. I can add an override route for AcmeCorp to use model-compat-525.
priya: Also suggest lowering `blkio.weight` for snapshot job containers to reduce IO pressure.
mike: Quick commands I ran: 
```
# check nvme latency
nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0 | grep "crit_warn"
# throttle snapshot container
docker update --blkio-weight=10 snapshot-job-1234
```
alex: Doing route override now for customer: `route set acmecorp -> model-compat-525 ap-southeast-1-realtime-01:node-8`
cs-sara: AcmeCorp reports improvement within 3 min -> p95 back to ~140ms :tada:
priya: Great. Next steps for root cause: collect perf traces across host kernel, nvme, driver traces during snapshot window.
infra-ryan: I'll capture `perf record` and `iostat -x` for a controlled snapshot on a staging node with 530.
mike: Also file upstream bug with GPU driver vendor and include our perf+nvme traces. Might be interaction with new DMA batching defaults.
alex: Action items: infra-ryan throttle snapshot job + collect traces (in 2h), mike file vendor ticket, priya coordinate host kernel trace, cs-sara confirm customer is stable.
cs-sara: Noted, customer updated and ok for now. I'll keep watch.
priya: If we see recurrence, we should plan a targeted rollback for region and add snapshot QoS controls in orchestration.
infra-ryan: Added temp throttling rule and route override expires in 6h unless we change it.
mike: Filing ticket: RB-2026-311 (vendor driver 530 + host IO tail). Assigning to vendor/driver-team with perf bundle.
alex: Thanks all. Keep this thread for updates, paste traces here when ready. :eyes:
